findings.evidence: List of Figures on page iv, List of Tables on page vii, Preface on page ix, Chapter 1 on page 1/2
findings.issue: Front matter uses Roman numeral page numbering (iv, vii, ix) which is distinct from the body's Arabic numbering (1-561). This is standard book typography but can cause confusion for automated text extraction tools that assume sequential integer page indices.
findings.fix_instruction: No action required. This is a documentation feature for manual verification: when referencing 'page 1', clarify if it means physical PDF page 1 (cover) or logical body page 1 (Chapter 1, physical page 26). In this JSON, 'page' refers to the logical content location (e.g., 'Preface', 'Ch. 7 Table 7-1').
